    # The bars and blocks form a sequence. Slide each successive object up and

    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    by_color = {}

    objs=[]

        objs.append((cmin,color,cells,rmin))

    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    dr=dc=0
    for i,(cmin,color,cells,rmin) in enumerate(objs):
